components.html:
Zaak data in a form

Every row shows one property of the zaak: on the left the expression, next to it what it renders. ZAC puts the zaak in the form's template context, so {{ zaak.identificatie }} in a content component is all that is needed — there is no ZAC attribute or property involved. Nested properties work as you would expect: {{ zaak.zaaktype.omschrijving }}.

Three helper functions come with it: {{ datum(zaak.startdatum) }} and {{ jaNee(zaak.isOpen) }} for display, and {{ lijst(zaak.kenmerken, "kenmerk") }} to read one property of every element of a list. Several values can go in one sentence, which is what a content component is for.

Almost nothing reports a mistake. A misspelled property renders as empty, and so does a property read through an object the zaak does not have — behandelaar.naam on an unassigned zaak is a correct expression, not a mistake, and renders nothing rather than failing. An object renders [object Object]. Only an unknown function is loud, and only in the browser console. The last panel shows each of those. Markup in a zaak value is removed before the form ever sees it, so a value cannot inject anything.
{{ dutchDate(zaak.startdatum) }} — an unknown function; the only mistake that says so, in the browser console
